fact: Italic is one property of the whole text element, turned on and off by an "Italic" toggle in the properties panel (tooltip "Italic (Ctrl+I)") and by Ctrl+I (Cmd+I on macOS); there is no partial italic, no separate italic font, and bold is out of scope.

fact: Italic works with every font, using a synthetic slant where a font has no italic face, and italic text stays readable and unclipped in Latin, Cyrillic, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Hebrew, emoji and mixed scripts with direction and alignment unchanged.
